adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` compute the calendar id as:

- `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`

Because the `.find(...)` branch only runs when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, the predicate `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` compares against `undefined/null`, which will not match any normal `externalId` string. This makes the fallback effectively dead and causes `selectedCalendar/calendarId` to resolve to `undefined` when `externalCalendarId` is missing, rather than selecting a destination calendar from `event.destinationCalendar`, leading to updates/deletes hitting the wrong calendar (or failing / defaulting unexpectedly).
